Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of The CONTROLLER, CQA(ME) payable at PUNE . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidders offer may be REJECTED if proper documents are not submitted. Documents like MSME Certif icate, GST Certificate, EPF Certificate, ISO-9001 Certificate, Proof of having Registered Office in PUNE are t o be uploaded. 2. Bidder also needs to upload Experience Details from previous contracts through GeM portal only. 3. After award of Contract successful bidder has to submit PBG @3% of the total value of the contract withi n 15days. 4. After award of Contract successful bidder has to submit PVR Certificate of the deployed staff. 5. After award of Contract successful bidder has to disburse the payment to their staff through E- Payment mode only, to their Bank Accounts. 6. Attendance sheet duly signed by the supervisor and verified by security officer to be submitted along wi th monthly bill. 7. Copies of GST Challan, EPF Challan, invoice, Contractor bill duly signed as to be submitted along with m onthly bill. . 7. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider
